name: The four passions (krodha, māna, māyā, lobha) with their four varieties
description: Anger, pride, deceit and greed (8.9): counted among the rising states of the soul (2.6), a division of the sāmparāyika inflow (6.5), the ground of conduct-deluding karma (6.14, 8.9), a cause of bondage (8.1) and the reason the soul takes in karma-particles (8.2); each has four varieties, anantānubandhī, apratyākhyāna, pratyākhyāna and saṃjvalana (8.9), which the sūtra names but does not define.

checks.note: Corrected by J: the shard's obs:kasaya entry (Jain passions) was folded in here (description and rests_on), because data obs:kasaya is a different thing (the Advaita/Gauḍīya meditation fault of latent attachment).

name: The non-passions (akaṣāya/nokaṣāya): nine
description: Laughter, liking, disliking, grief, fear, disgust and the three sex-drives, named as the second group of conduct-deluding karma (8.9).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.

name: The five causes of bondage
description: Wrong view, non-abstinence, carelessness, passions and activity (8.1).

checks.note: Entity read against the teachings it rests on and their segments: faithful; level not raised by J.
